description_en: Queries the audit logs of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的审计日志
name: DescribeAuditRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node in the instance. Specify this parameter to query the monitoring information of a specific node.

This parameter is available only when the instance uses the read/write splitting or cluster architecture.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html operation to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例中的节点ID。传入本参数可查询指定节点的监控信息。

当实例的架构为读写分离或集群架构时，本参数才可用。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html接口查询节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the account. If you do not specify this parameter, the audit logs of all accounts are queried
parameters.help_zh: 账号名称，默认（不填任何值）表示查询所有账号
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The database in the instance. If you do not specify this parameter, the audit logs of all databases are queried. Valid values: 0 to 255. For example, 0 indicates database 0
parameters.help_zh: 实例中的Database，默认（不填任何值）表示查询所有DB，取值为0 ~ 255，示例0表示DB 0
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The keyword used to query audit logs based on a specific command. By default, the audit logs of all executed commands are queried.

You can specify only one keyword
parameters.help_zh:
根据指定的命令查询审计日志，默认查询所有执行过的命令。

只能传入单个关键词
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client. If you do not specify this parameter, the audit logs of all IP addresses are queried
parameters.help_zh: 客户端IP，默认（不填任何值）为查询所有地址
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的最大记录数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Because audit logs contain a large number of entries, specify a time range of up to 10 minutes and a maximum of 1 day
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 由于审计日志的条目数较多，一般查询的时间范围建议在10分钟以内，最长不超过1天
parameters.name: end_time

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the query.

The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format and displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
查询结束时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间

SQL.description_en: The collection of audit log entries
SQL.description_zh: 由审计日志组成的集合

ExecuteTime.description_en:
The execution time.

The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format and displayed in UTC
ExecuteTime.description_zh:
执行时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间

HostAddress.description_en: The IP address of the client

NodeId.description_en:
The ID of the node.
This parameter is returned only when the instance uses the cluster or read/write splitting architecture
NodeId.description_zh:
节点ID。
实例为集群或读写分离架构时，本参数才会返回具体的节点ID

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the page to return

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的最大记录数

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the query.

The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format and displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh:
查询开始时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间
